after: избирательный округ с намеренно искажёнными границами; джерримендеринг
why: Wrong referent: -инг in джерримендеринг names the practice of redrawing districts, but this entry's gloss defines the district itself ("A voting district drawn with unfair boundaries") and all three examples treat the noun as a countable object, not an activity — "Critics called the new map a blatant gerrymander", "The court threw out the district as an illegal gerrymander", "Both parties have drawn gerrymanders". None of those parse if the word means "нарезка округов": you cannot draw or throw out a practice. The entry's own contrast note reinforces the split, saying the activity sense is expressed as *gerrymandering*. The district sense now leads; джерримендеринг is kept second so the learner still gets the recognizable Russian term.
